author: blu
body: On a half-duplex bus the line is either receiving (driver disabled, the safe idle state) or driving (driver enabled, transmitting).

author: blu
body: On a shared RS485 bus, permission to drive the line is a resource: acquire it before transmitting, thread it through each transmission, and release it exactly once so other nodes can take the bus. The grant is linear -- the compiler rejects a path that drops it (leaving the bus driven) or one that reuses it after release.
